newsitem.title: USA: Nissan plans electric vehicle for Calif..
newsitem.headline: Nissan plans electric vehicle for Calif..

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd will introduce a new electric vehicle with a 120-mile driving range to the California market in early 1998, the automaker said Monday at the Electric Vehicle Symposium in Osaka, Japan.

The new vehicle will be a four-passenger compact van built on a new platform to accommodate either a gasoline engine or an electric motor. The design of the new model will be revealed closer to its public introduction.
Nissan said the battery charger will use an inductive charging system and acceleration performance similar to that of gasoline-powered vehicles.
